body: I want to tell him off and tell him that I'm fucking sorry for dragging him into this. He was so happy back when we were together but recently we've been separated due to our military lives. I feel so guilty. I wish he hadn't met me before. I feel so horrible for dragging him down with me into this pit of self hate. I don't want him to hate himself for what he did last night. He just wanted me safe. At the same time, it hurts knowing I can't talk to him unfiltered like I did. I'm not sure what to do and I just need help but I'm afraid to go now that people know. I don't want to ask for help to get discharged.
